summary.text: Phillip Lowe is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 60, who assumed office in 2006 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a physical therapist and developer, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Lowe attended Francis Marion University and the University of South Carolina and received a B.S. from the Medical University of South Carolina in 1982.
He first assumed office in the South Carolina House in 2006, and Ballotpedia lists him on the House Rules Committee and the Ways and Means Committee for the 2025-2026 session.
